name: healthcare-platform-backend
description: AI-Based Healthcare Monitoring and Management System - REST API + WebSocket

scripts.db:connect: node -e "const mysql=require('mysql2/promise');require('dotenv').config();(async()=>{const p=mysql.createPool({host:process.env.DB_HOST,port:parseInt(process.env.DB_PORT),user:process.env.DB_USER,password:process.env.DB_PASSWORD,database:process.env.DB_NAME,connectTimeout:20000});try{const c=await p.getConnection();const[r]=await c.query('SELECT VERSION() AS v');console.log('Connected! MySQL version:',r[0].v);const[t]=await c.query('SHOW TABLES');console.log('Tables found:',t.length);t.forEach(row=>console.log(' -',Object.values(row)[0]));c.release();}catch(e){console.error('Connection failed:',e.message);}finally{await p.end();}})()"
